name: Runner Extras - Session Company Default
brief: Issue #3400: the runner's session company is the literal "My Company", a runner invention no service tier can confirm. This suite pins the literal and that the Company row and Record.CurrentCompany() name the same company.
description: Runner-mechanism claim. What the corpus pins about CompanyName() on a real service tier - non-empty, equal to Record.CurrentCompany(), resolvable in Company - is BC behaviour and stays upstream. This suite asserts only the runner's chosen literal, written by two separate seeds: the skeleton NavCompany in AlRunner/BcRuntime.cs and the Company (2000000006) row. GuiAllowed() = true is deliberately NOT asserted here: corpus codeunit 60173 GuiAllowed_InTestContext_ReturnsTrue pins it on real BC and runs through the runner on every leg. See docs/limitations.md.
